title: Overdue Deep-Clean Tasks
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tidy:schedule days_overdue=* task_status=*
| where days_overdue>0 AND task_status!="done"
| sort - days_overdue
| table task_name days_overdue estimated_minutes task_status
description: Lists Tidy scheduled cleaning tasks that are past due and not marked complete.
value: Overdue deep cleans pile into weekend marathons; a backlog view spreads work across the month.
implementation: Export Tidy tasks with `days_overdue` and review the open queue every Sunday planning session.
visualization: Table of overdue tasks sorted by days overdue.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks cleaning chores on your schedule that you keep putting off.
